official_xp.historical_sheet: Vaastav xP is not a benchmark and not a feature. The README says it is ep_this scraped after the gameweek, and the timing is uncertain.
official_xp.live_only: A test that reads official xP fails unless every row has a timezone-aware captured_at strictly before the canonical deadline for that gameweek.

encompassing.formula: total_points = a + b * official_xp + c * score_xp
encompassing.population: 2026-27 from gameweek 6, pre-deadline captures of official xP and the engine only

decision_slice.population: eligible rows only: n_prior >= 3 and xmi >= 45
decision_slice.rank: Spearman of the score against total_points within season, gameweek and position

placebo.shuffle: eligible finite score_xp within each gameweek

common_state.squad: price-ladder fifteen, tie-break lower player id, score unused
common_state.shuffle: eligible finite score_xp within each gameweek

disagreement.population: common-state weeks where the two moves differ
disagreement.floor: conditional bootstrap, minimum 5 disagreement weeks, 20-week season floor does not apply

initial_squad.opener: one-week MILP at the first week all four fifteens exist

loso.estimator: mean of concatenated stored weeks; bootstrap resamples gameweeks inside each remaining season

eligibility.xg: at least one player with minutes > 0 and expected_goals > 0
eligibility.prior_season: an earlier season is in the closed archive

note: Gaussian log score with sigma fixed at 3. The bootstrap resamples gameweeks, not player rows. 2026-27 is not in the closed-season comparison. Gameweeks 1-5 of that season were already read. The clean holdout starts at gameweek 6. A season total is not a pass. The decision batch scores score_xp. From gameweek 6 the live choice primary is ep_next and score_xp is logged as the shadow. Promotion needs the paired interval of score_xp minus ep_next to stay strictly above zero on at least 20 pre-deadline weeks. An interval that covers zero is undetermined, and the test continues through gameweek 38. From gameweek 6 the live squad is chosen by captured ep_next. score_xp is logged in shadow and does not choose. The historical score column stays score_xp. The eligible pool is the primary closed-season result and the all-weeks pool is the sensitivity. The decision capture is the same-stamp pair from the window three hours to fifteen minutes before the deadline. An earlier file is not used. The review is at gameweek 26. The reversion diagnostic does not install a feature. Oracle minutes use the same fixture and are not a forecast.
